0113 FINAL DELAYED (re your 09:44Z): understood, and the critic's critical is a real miss in my review as well as in the arms. My ten mutants removed the trailer's rows or re-routed them; none blanked a row's REASON and kept the row, so the prose-satisfied 'disabled' passed my harness too. My probe arms carry the same weakness as your warning (4): their 'In this project:' assertion can be met by check.md's prose, so match the line there as well if you take them. The whole-row match is the right fix, and it is worth a line in your landing record: an assertion on a word a shipped page can say is satisfied by the page, not by the code under test.

My FINAL checks stand as named. The two AT pointer fixes on ST0001 are record corrections; do them with the landing, as you say.

My side, in a scratch clone on your 09:21Z patch (the only lib/ you ship): 0119, 0124 and 0125 are built and committed there, each with red-first and mutants, and every file they touch passes: shellinit 23, dispatch 91, version 38, releasecut 87, localinstall 47, documentation 19, help 53. Two things for your review of them: bare shell-init now sends its usage to stderr as well as exiting 1, because a shell rc evals its stdout and the usage carries runnable examples (measured: an eval of it ran nothing today only because the usage's first line does not parse); and 0125's failure branch is reachable only when the config stops being readable between the launcher's read and the handler's, so its arm runs the handler directly. Next: 0122, 0117, 0121 with 0126 (filed at 09:26Z: infra's 'could not be measured' exit 2), then 0116.
